description:
Let's be honest — we all have pests. There's a whole culture around hiding it, pretending our plants are thriving when really we're quietly losing the battle. But keeping quiet also means we never share what actually works.

Nature figured out the solution millions of years ago. We just made it easy to get. Partner with FGMN Nursery, share predatory mites with your audience, and help build a community that talks openly about pests — and beats them naturally.

Earn 12% commission on every sale you refer. Your audience gets 10% off. Everyone's plants win.

FGMN Nursery

Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Effective Date: March 15, 2026

1. Agreement to Terms

By registering for the FGMN Nursery Affiliate Program ("Program"), you ("Affiliate") agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions ("Agreement"). FGMN Nursery reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued participation in the Program following any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.


2. Eligibility

To participate in the Program, you must:

  • Be a legal resident of one of the 48 contiguous United States
  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Have an active online presence relevant to plants, gardening, pest control, horticulture, agriculture, or related fields
  • Comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws
  • Complete a valid W-9 form prior to receiving any commission payments


3. Commission Structure

Affiliates earn commissions on approved referral sales according to the following tiered structure, based on total monthly referred sales:

  • Entry Tier: 10% commission on monthly referred sales up to $499
  • Mid Tier: 15% commission on monthly referred sales of $500 to $1,499
  • Top Tier: 20% commission on monthly referred sales of $1,500 and above


Tier levels are evaluated and reset monthly. Affiliates will automatically advance or revert tiers based on their performance during the prior month. Commission is calculated on the subtotal of referred orders, excluding taxes and shipping.


4. Tracking & Cookie Window

FGMN Nursery uses a 60-day cookie window. Affiliates will receive credit for any qualifying purchase made within 60 days of a customer clicking their unique affiliate link. If a customer uses both an affiliate link and a coupon code from the same affiliate, only one commission will be issued. If a customer uses an affiliate link from one affiliate and a coupon code from another, the coupon code affiliate will receive the commission.


5. Gift With Purchase Program

Each approved affiliate is entitled to offer their audience a complimentary custom-labeled gift with purchase. Available gift options include:

  • Predatory mite prevention sachets
  • Ladybugs
  • Lacewing eggs
  • T-22 (Trichoderma harzianum)


Affiliates may choose to have their gift labeled with their name, their brand or handle, or both. The gift with purchase is fulfilled automatically with qualifying orders placed through the affiliate's unique link or coupon code. FGMN Nursery reserves the right to substitute a gift of equal or greater value in the event of stock unavailability.


6. Payments

Commission payments are subject to the following conditions:

  • Minimum payout threshold: $50. Commissions below this threshold will roll over to the following month.
  • Payment is issued monthly on the 15th of the following calendar month (e.g., January commissions are paid on February 15th). If the 15th falls on a weekend or federal holiday, payment will be issued on the next business day.
  • Payment methods: PayPal or bank transfer. Affiliates must provide valid payment details in their affiliate dashboard.
  • FGMN Nursery is not responsible for payment delays caused by incorrect or incomplete payment information provided by the Affiliate.
  • All payments are in US dollars.


7. Tax Obligations

Affiliates are responsible for all taxes applicable to commissions received. A completed W-9 form is required before any payments are issued. Affiliates who earn $600 or more in a calendar year will receive a 1099 form. FGMN Nursery will withhold 24% backup withholding from any affiliate who fails to provide a valid W-9.


8. No Refund Policy & Living Products

FGMN Nursery sells living biological products. Due to the perishable nature of these products, all sales are final and no refund window applies. Commissions will be approved once an order is confirmed as delivered and payment is successfully processed. Commissions associated with orders that result in chargebacks, payment disputes, or fraud will be automatically voided and forfeited.


9. Prohibited Conduct

The following activities are strictly prohibited and will result in immediate termination of your affiliate account and forfeiture of all pending commissions:

  • Self-referrals: placing orders through your own affiliate link or coupon code
  • Cookie stuffing or any artificial inflation of clicks, impressions, or referrals
  • Placing orders using stolen, fraudulent, or unauthorized payment methods
  • Sharing affiliate coupon codes on public coupon aggregator websites or deal forums
  • Bidding on FGMN Nursery branded keywords in paid search advertising
  • Making false, misleading, or unsubstantiated claims about FGMN Nursery products
  • Spamming any individual or platform with affiliate links or promotional material
  • Violating any applicable federal, state, or local law in connection with your participation in the Program


10. Minor Violations

For non-fraudulent violations of these terms, FGMN Nursery may, at its discretion, issue a written warning before proceeding to account termination. FGMN Nursery reserves the right to determine, at its sole discretion, whether a violation is minor or serious in nature.


11. FTC Disclosure Requirements

Affiliates must clearly and conspicuously disclose their affiliate relationship with FGMN Nursery in all promotional content, in accordance with the Federal Trade Commission's guidelines on endorsements and testimonials. Failure to comply with FTC disclosure requirements may result in immediate termination.


12. Intellectual Property

FGMN Nursery grants each Affiliate a non-exclusive, revocable, non-transferable license to use FGMN Nursery-approved logos, images, and marketing materials solely for the purpose of promoting the Program. This license may be revoked at any time. Affiliates may not:

  • Modify, alter, distort, or misrepresent FGMN Nursery logos, branding, or products
  • Use "FGMN Nursery" or any variation thereof in their own domain names, website URLs, or social media handles
  • Register any trademark, domain, or social media account that could be confused with FGMN Nursery
  • Use FGMN Nursery branding in any way that implies endorsement, partnership, or employment beyond the affiliate relationship


All intellectual property rights remain the exclusive property of FGMN Nursery.


13. Independent Contractor Status

Affiliates are independent contractors and not employees, agents, partners, or legal representatives of FGMN Nursery. Affiliates have no authority to bind FGMN Nursery to any obligation. FGMN Nursery is not responsible for withholding, collecting, or paying any taxes, social security, or other payroll deductions on behalf of any Affiliate. Affiliates are solely responsible for their own tax obligations arising from commissions received.


14. Termination

FGMN Nursery reserves the right to suspend or terminate any affiliate account at any time, with or without cause. Upon termination, any pending commissions associated with fraudulent or violating activity will be forfeited. Legitimately earned commissions that meet the minimum payout threshold at the time of termination will be paid out at the next scheduled payment date.


15. Limitation of Liability

FGMN Nursery shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your participation in the Program. FGMN Nursery's total liability to any Affiliate shall not exceed the total commissions paid to that Affiliate in the three months prior to the event giving rise to the claim.


16. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the state in which FGMN Nursery is incorporated, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.


17. Contact

For questions regarding this Agreement or the Program, please contact us through your affiliate dashboard or via our website at fgmnnursery.com.



By registering for the FGMN Nursery Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.
